items.name: Source
items.tip: What the plugin hears. In a DAW this is the track you put Copycat on. Your file uses the file you loaded.

items.name: Listen
items.tip: Play the source on a loop, like a track in your DAW. Shortcut: Space.

items.name: Capture 2 s
items.tip: Grab 2 seconds of what is playing now and analyze it. Shortcut: C.

items.name: Auto capture
items.tip: While listening, grab a new 2 second window every time the loop turns. Off keeps the picture frozen.

items.name: Load file
items.tip: Load your own audio file (wav, mp3, flac, ogg). It stays in this browser tab and is never uploaded.

items.name: Sound
items.tip: Spectrogram of the captured sound: time to the right, frequency up. Hover to read a note. Shortcut: 1.

items.name: Synth guess
items.tip: Harmonics of the sound against a saw, square and triangle. The closest one is the guess. Shortcut: 2.

items.name: Envelope & filter
items.tip: Amp envelope with draggable points, and the filter curve. Shortcut: 3.

items.name: EQ curve
items.tip: Average spectrum of the sound and an EQ you can draw to match it. Shortcut: 4.

items.name: Recipes
items.tip: Written recipes to rebuild the sound in a synth. Shortcut: 5.

items.name: Original
items.tip: Play the captured sound once.

items.name: Copy
items.tip: Play the rebuilt copy once: the recipe on the Synth guess and Envelope tabs, played by the built-in synth.

items.name: Window 100 %
items.tip: Window size. Drag any edge or corner of the plugin to resize it; the shape stays the same. Double-click here for 100 %.

items.name: Resize
items.tip: Drag to resize the window. Every edge and corner works, and the shape stays the same.

items.name: Resonance
items.tip: Filter resonance. Double-click resets.

items.name: Filter env
items.tip: How far the envelope opens the filter above its cutoff. Double-click resets.
